articleTitle: Confronting Hate Speech in SMART Environments: An Approach that Uses Ensemble Learning and LSTM
abstract: In the current digital age of the Internet and online virtualization, it has established different kinds of online media, such as social media: two important and most pervasive ways of communicating. However, it becomes a little hard for them to deal with the responsibility, i.e., to regulate and filter the toxic or harmful content across the platform, specifically in filtering out the offensive comments posted by the users. In this work, we are particularly interested in the main mission of hate comment detection. Our major objective is to flag those comments which are offensive, harmful, and abusive in an online conversation. This paper proposes an original ensembling based learning scheme, taking the power of LSTM neural networks, to solve this crucial problem. LSTMs, specially designed types of RNNs, have shown to be effective in sequence modeling and also demonstrated some promising results in problems related to sequences. Our methodology is based on the existence of certain LSTM models of small size, which are trained on an independent fraction of all completed and pre-processed data. This approach allows the ensemble to capture the diversity in patterns; hence, it contributes to the large robustness of hate comment detection. In an ever-globalized and digitized world, the advent of dependable methodologies for hate comment detection becomes cardinal in acquiring safe and inclusive online environments. Our research is a promising step towards reducing online toxicity in order to have healthier and more constructive digital conversations.

articleTitle: Improving Lane Management: Leveraging OpenCV and IoT to Empower Smart Environments
abstract: Lane detection is an essential component of autonomous driving systems that allows vehicles to travel the road safely. This study offer a technique to detection using OpenCV, a famous computer vision toolkit, in this research paper. To extract lane boundaries from photos and videos acquired by a camera mounted on a vehicle, this study use a combination of colour space transformation, edge detection, and image thresholding approaches. This study also offers a real time lane recognition system that proves approach’s effectiveness in recognizing lane borders in real-world circumstances. Road safety is a crucial concern as accidents are becoming more frequent due to driver inattention. To decrease accidents & ensure safety, technological advancements need to be made. One important effective method is using Lane Detection Systems, which can detect lane borders on the road and alert drivers if they cross them. Though it is among the most difficult of the elements to be detected, since the condition of the roads keeps changing, especially at night and under different lighting conditions, lane detection is still one of the vital components in an advanced transportation system. Lane boundary detection is where a camera in a vehicle is mounted on the front and images of the roads are acquired with it. In this paper, the methodology to divide the image of a video image into sub-images and the extracted features of the image are applied to identify the lanes. Based on this realization brings to the forefront the proposed techniques in lane marking detection and the ability of the work to enhance the knowledge base further. It is one big challenge in the way to fully autonomous vehicles because the software may not provide accurate detection, which may raise serious security concerns.

articleTitle: Consumer Sentiment Analysis
abstract: The method of employing natural language processing to comprehend & gauge consumers’ thoughts & feelings are known as consumer sentiment analysis. It is mostly used to assess consumer evaluations, social media posts, and survey results. Businesses mostly utilize it to increase sales, customer satisfaction, product quality, and to create more powerful marketing campaigns. This study paper examines the various difficulties encountered and the most recent developments that can be made to obtain a more precise analysis of the consumer’s feelings and behavior. This will also assist in describing the many uses of customer sentiment analysis. In order to improve sales, services, and product quality, firms can use this paper to gather real-time client feedback.

articleTitle: Improving Home Security through Facial Recognition in a Smart Environment
abstract: Ensuring the safety & security of our homes is of prime importance, & the conventional methods of door unlocking systems, dependent on physical keys, passwords, or biometrics, often pose challenges due to their susceptibility to loss, theft, or sharing. This abstract introduces the concept of leveraging facial recognition technology as a cutting-edge solution for securing residential doorways. In this research, we address the critical challenge of developing a dependable, rapid, and precise door-unlocking system powered by facial recognition. The proposed system utilizes a camera to capture an image of the user’s face, subsequently comparing it with an existing facial profile stored securely within a database. The core technology stack employed for this endeavor comprises Python and OpenCV libraries, harnessing their capabilities to ensure the seamless functioning of the facial recognition algorithm. This research aim to modify the way to protect homes, providing an efficient, user-friendly & an alternative to traditional locking system. With the usage of advance technology like facial recognition for smart homes, residents can enjoy the ease of self-face as key to unlock their doors, enhancing security as well as ease of access. Research Article sets the stage for further exploration of the project’s methodology, results, and implications, ultimately contributing to the advancement of smart home security along with integration of cutting-edge technologies into everyday life

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Skin Cancer Detection in a Smart Ecosystem
abstract: Skin cancer is a form of cancer that originates in skin tissue and can lead to harm, disability, and even death by affecting the surrounding tissue. Early and accurate diagnosis, followed by prompt treatment, are essential to minimize and manage the adverse consequences of skin cancer. Physicians often spend significant time distinguishing between skin cancer and benign tumor lesions due to their similar appearances. In this study, a system was developed to automatically detect skin cancer using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The proposed study employs various optimizers, including the highly effective Adam optimizer. Notably, the Adam optimizer achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 94% in identifying skin cancer from the dataset.

articleTitle: Smart Model For Black Friday Sales Prediction
abstract: In the United States and other nations, Black Friday is a significant shopping holiday. Businesses are anxious to forecast their Black Friday sales so they can organize their inventory and marketing initiatives. A smart machine learning based strategy is provided for predicting Black Friday sales in this study. A variety of linear regression, decision trees, and random forests are examples of machine learning methods used. The dataset that we used in this project is ‘Black Friday Sale Prediction’. We find that the linear regression gives the best result for the model. The result shows that it is possible to predict Black Friday sales with a high root mean square error(RMSE).

articleTitle: Smart Technology Enhancing User-Centric Movie Recommendations
abstract: Everyone, regardless of their age, gender, ethnicity, color, or location, finds pleasure in watching movies. This medium connects us all in a unique way. What’s even more thrilling is how diversified our tastes in movies can be. Some people opt for definite genres: thrillers, romances, science fiction, or are interested in actors and directors. With such tastes, it’s pretty impossible to generalize this or that particular movie to please most of them. However, there’s a group of people who share similar movie tastes. This is where I, as a data scientist, come in. Without further ado, let’s dive into the basics of such a system by analyzing behaviors and movie trends within the audience to build recommendation systems.

articleTitle: AI Technological advancements in the design of intangible cultural products and Preservation of Cultural Heritage Sites
abstract: Culture plays a significant role in shaping audience’s behavior, especially in this digitalized era, where large portion of any individual’s day is spent online resulting in building global integration of people belonging to different cultures. Therefore, Cultural Products and Heritage Sites are also equally important as it holds a major part of any country’s glorious and rich history and can earn recognition at a global level for any country. The main aim of this paper was to identify latest advancements in 4.0 enabling technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Virtual Reality (VR) and big data in innovatively digitally designing intangible cultural products and measures for ensuring long term sustainability of Cultural Heritage Sites (CHS). This paper has also given some future recommendations for the smooth management and establishing creative digital data base set design for CHS.

articleTitle: Soil Monitoring Using Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: Soil monitoring is important aspect of agriculture to grow good quality food. It is crucial aspect for famers and the environmental scientists as well. If soil is monitored properly then chances of good quality crop increased which reduces farmer’s tension and increase their income. This research paper is a step towards applying machine learning algorithms for soil monitoring. Decision Tree Regression, Random Forest Regression, Gradient Boosting Regressor and Stacking Regressor are such algorithms. Comparison analysis of these techniques are also done in this paper. This work will be helpful for farmers and land managers to accurately predict about the soil fertility which will further help them to take decision which crop should be grow as per the soil condition.

articleTitle: Smart Innovation in Motion: The Voice-Driven Robotic Vehicle Experience
abstract: This study explores the innovative realm of voice-driven robotic vehicles, focusing on a sophisticated system where voice command plays a large role in controlling the robot. The core components of this system include an Android application & a microcontroller, collaborating seamlessly to execute intricate tasks. The Android application establishes a wireless connection with the robotic vehicle thru Bluetooth technology. Users have the flexibility to interact with the robot through the application's user-friendly interface, either by tapping on designated buttons or by issuing voice command. These voice commands serve as an instruction for controlling the robotic vehicle's movements. At the heart of the robotic vehicle lies a microcontroller, intricately linked to 02 DC servo motors responsible for maneuvering the robot's physical motion. The Bluetooth RF transmitter converts the user's commands within the application into the digital signals for wireless transmission. On the receiving end, the data is decoded & relayed to the microcontroller, which interprets these signals to drive the DC motors, orchestrating the desired movements of the robot. The primary objective of this voice-controlled robotic vehicle system is to provide an intuitive & responsive interaction experience. Users can communicate their instructions to the robot through voice commands, enabling it to execute tasks precisely as directed. To facilitate this seamless interaction, a preconfigured code is employed to instruct the microcontroller, ensuring a synchronized and efficient operation of the robotic vehicle. This study delves into the technical intricacies and the user experience aspects of this exciting innovation in the field of robotics.

articleTitle: Designing and Prototyping Low Cost Portable Ventilator for Emergency uses
abstract: A ventilator is a medical device that provides mechanical ventilation to a patient unable to breathe independently. It is the requirement of every healthcare center and rescue service, but unfortunately, such life-saving machines are deficient in those departments. The reasons behind it are the high price, complex structure, and portability. This paper presents a cost-effective microcontroller-based mechanical ventilation approach that would decrease overall cost and size of machine. The hardware setup contains an air pump in collaboration with flow sensor, pressure sensor, oxygen sensor, alarms, and LCD reduce the cost and size while increasing the device's effectiveness. The flow sensor is in charge of measuring air flow in order to maintain desired tidal volume, minute volume, and minute flow within a user-defined I/E (inspiratory to expiratory time ratio) and breathing rate, whereas the pressure sensor measures airway pressure instantaneously to ensure device trigger sensitivity, i.e., allows the patient to initiate new breath as the designed device works in volume/assist control ventilation mode. The LCD shows all the selected parameters to facilitate the device's operation. Alarms inform the user when some critical event occurs, i.e., overpressure, oxygen level, and trigger sensitivity. Because of its low cost and smallest size, the designed portable ventilator will facilitate patients in remote areas of developing and semi-developing countries.

articleTitle: Leveraging Smart Devices for Corporate Social Responsibility in India: Advancements, Trends, and Concerns towards Sustainability
abstract: As India progresses towards the achievement of global sustainability goals the integration of IoT and smart devices in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives can emerge as a promising avenue which can enhance the impact and efficiency of the environmental and social initiatives undertaken by the Indian companies. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) reflects commitment of corporate houses to operate morally, ethically and contribute towards the economic growth and development while also facilitating in improving the quality of life of worker and their families, as well as the local community and society at large. In recent years it has been acknowledged as a vital component of corporate strategy worldwide. Spurred by mandatory laws and increasing social expectation for businesses to play a more active role in addressing social and environmental challenges, CSR activities has witnessed a notable surge in India..The current study is conducted to investigate the application of latest advancements and patterns in smart devices for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities with reference to Indian companies, with a focus on achieving Sustainability goals. Further the study also aims to investigate the patterns and trends associated with integrating the smart devices while conducting CSR with a focus on achieving SDGs. The study also aims to explore various challenges and concerns which may take place while adopting smart devices for CSR in the Indian context. The paper also explores case of companies implementing smart CSR initiatives in the country and the study also comes out with certain recommendations for businesses and policymakers to optimize the application of smart devices in CSR practices for achieving global sustainability goals. The current study is designed to provide valuable insights regarding the integration of smart devices with CSR thus enabling the companies to take informed decisions and align their CSR initiatives with national and global sustainable development goals.

articleTitle: The perspectives of women on telecommuting in the IT sector: A boon or a curse
abstract: During Covid-19, when women were allowed to work from home, it became clear that they were adept at juggling multiple jobs at once. During this time, working women faced a number of obstacles and responsibilities, including a lack of domestic help, online classes for their children, and a number of other daily routine activities and office responsibilities. However, the condition of women who work from home did not improve after the epidemic, and it still does not. Therefore, from April 2023 to July 2023, a total of 309 working women from the IT sector in Delhi-NCR were surveyed in this study to determine what factors affect working women's attitudes regarding remote work. Using analysis of variance and t-tests, we tested our predictions and found that most female professionals felt overwhelmed. Current studies show that working from home is not only more challenging for women than working in an office but also less productive. Problems with time management, communication, and reaction time, as well as technical and mental difficulties, have a negative impact on their work. The most common hiccup they experience is sluggish internet speeds. Stress, frustration, anxiety, and the pressures of the workplace are just some of the mental health concerns they face. They have a work-life imbalance due to factors including family duties and doing extra work on their own time. Nearly nine in ten women believe the government should establish guidelines for remote work. Almost half of all women hope to one day work from home, while the other half have no such plans.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Waste Management AI-Powered Solutions for Electronic Waste in India
abstract: The rapid yearly rise of electronic trash (e-waste) is among the greatest urgent matters with waste management in the twenty-first century. Electronic wastes are a serious hazard to the surroundings and an issue for community health, especially in most industrialized nations. The phrase "electronic waste" refers to a range of electronic goods that have lost value and are viewed as superfluous by their owners. Globally, e-waste has recently increased at an unheard-of rate. The COVID-19 epidemic will further fuel this surge because of the evolving work culture where individuals are more reliant than ever on their technical devices. In 2020, India produced 3.2 million tonnes of electronic garbage, with major metropolises. E-waste organization and recycling properly are essential for every modern city's sustainability nowadays. The environmental issues associated with electronic trash are discussed in this study, along with the artificial intelligence techniques used to manage that waste.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection using Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Pest-infested plants and crops have a negative effect on the nation's agricultural output. To detect and identify diseases in plants, farmers or other experts must keep a careful watch on plants. However, this method is frequently expensive, time-consuming, and inaccurate. Finding a spot on the leaves of the infected plant is one method of detecting plant diseases. This research aims to develop a disease detection model based on the classification of leaf images. To detect plant illnesses the proposed model utilizes image processing with a convolution neural network (CNN). This research work focus on three different plant diseases: tomato, corn and potato. Experimental results show high accuracy rate of 98.8%. Proposed work is also compared with some existing work working o same plants diseases.

articleTitle: Measurement of Tilting Status of Electric Pole Using Internet of Things
abstract: The way we connect to and engage with different things and urban infrastructure has been completely transformed by the Internet of Things (IoT), a paradigm shift in technology. IoT entails providing internet connectivity to various items, such as electrical poles and home appliances, in order to facilitate data collecting and communication. Real-time applications and monitoring are made possible by this connectivity since data is collected and delivered instantaneously or with no delay. The real-time data produced by IoT is crucial in the context of urban development and safety because it provides timely insights into the state of key city assets, ultimately enhancing environmental sustainability and public security. Monitoring the tilt status of electric poles in urban areas in real time is one specialized application of the IoT. To precisely gauge the angle or inclination of these essential infrastructure components, tilt sensing technology is used. The device can determine the stability and safety of electric poles by continuously measuring the tilt angle. An IoT-based solution is suggested to accomplish this, utilizing the NodeMCU development board. NodeMCU is a good option for IoT applications since it easily blends a microcontroller and Wi-Fi module. The NodeMCU serves as the key element in this system and is in charge of gathering data from tilt sensors and sending it over the internet.

articleTitle: World Coin Currency Detection: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning
abstract: In the economy where trade and finance are closely linked it is essential to accurately identify and authenticate various currencies, especially in industries such, as banking, tourism and retail. Conventional methods, for identifying coins typically require inspections or simple automated processes, which might take up a lot of time and are susceptible, to mistakes. The advancements, in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) technologies, over the years have revolutionized currency detection providing efficient solutions. This article discusses the evaluation of machine learning and deep learning approaches to identify types of coins. It explores how algorithms, like MobileNetV2, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) perform in distinguishing and classifying coin denominations across currencies. The results of experiments conducted on data sets show how these methods compare in terms of accuracy, effectiveness, and reliability. Furthermore, we examine the advantages and constraints of each approach while suggesting directions for advancing research, in the realm of identifying cryptocurrency.

articleTitle: Use of Artificial Intelligence in the fight against doping
abstract: Doping is the use of specific drugs and techniques to increase endurance and athletic performance because the body can provide more oxygen to muscles when these substances are ingested. It is now a global renowned problem. In fact, more powerful and untraceable techniques are now being used by sports person. Artificial intelligence may become a crucial weapon in curbing doping violations in sporting competitions. It may help to make the competitions cleaner and fairer in future. The existing techniques takes ample of time and money for testing of athletes. So, the methods of Artificial Intelligence can make doping checks faster and more efficient. This paper analysis the use of Artificial Intelligence techniques in curbing the violations of doping among athletes and how it will benefit national and international agency for providing clean and fair environment for athletes.

articleTitle: Exploring the concept of multi-modality using grounding dino with evaluation of its performance in the context of different types and complexity of input text prompts
abstract: We have known artificial intelligence, deep learning models can be trained with a certain type of input format to perform a task e.g., OCR models takes input in the form of image to read the text characters from the image, a weather prediction model can take weather data like wind speed, moisture, etc. as an input which is in text format to predict future weather data. But the multi-modality concept which is comparatively newer in the market paves the way for models to be built which can take more than one type of inputs e.g., text and audio, text and image, etc. In the same concept one of the popular architectures is specially designed for detection of any hindrance, model grounding dino about which we will be discussing in this setting. It is a zero-shot object detection model which can perform inference just by taking a text prompt input from the user describing what they want the model to detect in the provided image. In this study, we will be discussing about its capabilities, architecture and also its performance. We will be testing and quantifying its performance using standard self-created input text prompts with variations including description of the object, complexity of the object, etc. on a standard image.

articleTitle: MANA Cryptocurrency: Transactional Dynamics & Financial Metrics Study
abstract: This research investigates the emerging domain of the Metaverse, a digital realm that is significantly influencing social interactions and economic landscapes. This study aims to investigate the complex variables that contribute to the economic valuation of virtual properties on the Decentraland platform, which is a famous Metaverse platform. Despite the growing significance of the Metaverse and its status as a prominent economic force, there is a noticeable lack of empirical research examining the distinct dynamics of land valuation within this context. The current corpus of scholarly work mostly focuses on valuations in real-world contexts, resulting in a significant knowledge gap about the specific factors that influence land prices in the Metaverse. This research seeks to address the existing vacuum in knowledge by doing a comprehensive literature review and platform analysis. The primary objective is to provide insights into the various elements that influence the financial prospects of Metaverse lands. The anticipated results of this study are expected to provide significant contributions to the comprehension of Metaverse economics. Additionally, these findings will serve as a foundation for future research endeavors that aim to explore the convergence of virtual and physical realms in relation to financial value.

articleTitle: Using Smart Technology to Identify Pneumonia Accurately in Chest X-Rays
abstract: Pneumonia remains a highly prevalent and dangerous infectious disease of the respiratory system, with early and accurate detection deemed essential for effective treatment. This work is concerned with developing an automatic system for the recognition of pneumonia, named the Pneumonia Recognition System (PRS), through the analysis of digital chest X-ray images to assist in the diagnosis of this lethal disease. This system aims to improve the effectiveness of medical staff in early pneumonia detection through a quick and reliable diagnostic tool. Our PRS uses state-of-the-art techniques with the help of innovations; more specifically, CNNs analyze chest X-rays for signs indicative of pneumonia. We developed an extensive dataset in the thousands, which included X-ray images, for training and validating the model across different pneumonia and non-pneumonia cases. The model was trained and fine-tuned rigorously, which has led to great accuracy and sensitivity in the detection of pneumonia. It has further been tuned to reduce the number of false positives by large margins, which is an essential consideration in the clinical setup. In addition, time and workload burdens on the radiologists are poised to be reduced quite substantially from the exceptional diagnostic powers vested in this PRS so that they can better use their expertise more efficiently. In addition, it will be an essential tool in places where access to health facilities is poor and mainly because of this existing gap in early detection and treatment. Experimental results show the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed Pneumonia Recognition System. It holds promise to serve as an adjunctive diagnostic tool to better care for and improve patient outcomes in the fight against pneumonia. This requires further validation and clinical integration to realize its full benefit to patients and healthcare providers.

articleTitle: Monitoring Clinical Parameters through Machine Learning and Image Processing
abstract: The purpose of the paper is to find the clinical parameters of an individual using normal webcam. The paper aims to help the healthcare domain. In recent times there has been emergence of smartphone devices which monitor vital information’s. These devices have special sensors like Electrocardiogram (ECG) and Photoplethysmography (PPG) to check heart and respiratory rate. The smartphone camera reads the heart and respiratory data from the user's face. The method used in the paper mentions about the variation in the Hue that reads both heart and respiration rate from the face of a user. The result in the paper explains how the proposed approach gives more accurate results than the other detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Hy_PSO: Hybrid Algorithm for Lung Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis
abstract: As one of the primary causes of cancer-related death globally, lung cancer demands the development of sophisticated diagnostic and prognostic instruments in order to enhance patient outcomes. Lung cancer stands as one of the malignancies with significant morbidity and mortality rates. Imaging serves as a crucial component throughout the entire spectrum of lung cancer management, facilitating everything from initial detection to evaluating response to treatment. Innovations in medical imaging and image processing have created new opportunities for enhancing the diagnosis and prognosis of lung cancer. This study introduces a hybrid algorithm, termed the Hy_PSO algorithm, which combines the strengths of particle swarm optimization and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for classification tasks. Feature selection optimization significantly influences the accuracy of the classification model. Comparative analysis with other classification techniques, including support vector machines, artificial neural networks (ANNs), and CNNs, demonstrates the superiority of the proposed algorithm. Experimental results indicate its effectiveness in automatic lung tumor detection, surpassing contemporary methods in terms of accuracy (98.4%), sensitivity (99%), and specificity (97.65%). Hy_PSO combines many Machine Learning (ML) methods, including support vector machines (SVM), decision trees, and neural networks, to create prediction models after determining the ideal feature set. To find promising biomarkers for targeted medicines, estimate patient survival rates, and categorize lung cancer stages, these models are trained using the optimal characteristics. By utilizing the advantages of both PSO and machine learning, the hybrid technique makes sure that the prediction models are more robust and generalizable.

articleTitle: Wireless System for Monitoring of Water Tank Using Emerging Technologies
abstract: The constant increase in global population makes water management an urgent issue on a worldwide scale. There are lots of Innovative solutions have been developed in response to the requirement to effectively manage water resources in order to fulfil this expanding demand. In this situation, our proposed device can added advantage of the Internet of Things (IoT) to develop a system that successfully handles problems with water management as well as providing the real timer information to the consumers so that that can check about it. This proposed innovation has remote monitoring and control environment which makes it the perfect tool to address this problem as well already loaded with bunch of the features. Our system's is basically a customer centric innovation, by provide them friendly Mobile app UI so that they can monitor the water level in their tanks and control the tank filling procedure in few steps. Implementing a complex algorithm is necessary to accomplish this goal. Through the help of the relay module, this algorithm effectively manages tank filling, analyses data gathered by the water level sensor, and also provide the feedback to the users by providing live data, information and alert to the mobile application.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Enabled Automatic Meter Reading
abstract: The world is currently going through a huge transition towards digitalization and sustainability. Sustainability focuses on responsible resource management and environmental preservation, whereas digitalization entails the conversion of many processes and systems into connected, digital forms. Energy management, which aims to offer clean and affordable energy solutions while minimising waste and environmental damage, is one of the important sectors garnering significant attention in this context. Energy management involves the methodical optimisation of energy use in a variety of contexts, including commercial and industrial facilities and residential settings. The energy metre, a tool used to measure electricity, gas, or other energy kinds, is essential to this project. Traditional energy metres are evolving into "smart" energy metres, which may send consumption data periodically or in real-time in addition to measuring energy usage. The usability of energy metres is considerably increased by this feature for both consumers and energy suppliers. Industry 4.0 refers to the fourth industrial revolution, which is characterised by the incorporation of digital technologies into manufacturing and industrial processes, in the broader context of business and technology. Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and automation are key technologies advancing this transformation. These technologies are essential for improving productivity, sustainability, and efficiency across sectors. A key component of increasing energy management practises is the Internet of Things (IoT). The internet of things (IoT) is a network of connected gadgets and sensors that can gather and send data. IoT-enabled devices are crucial to the real-time monitoring and management of energy use in the field of energy management. These gadgets are capable of collecting information from many sources, such as energy metres, and transmitting it for analysis and well-informed decision-making. An IoT-improved Automatic Metre Reading (AMR) system is shown in the study. Energy metres can be remotely read using AMR technology, eliminating the requirement for manual intervention. In this case, IoT technology enhances the capabilities of the AMR system by being easily incorporated into it. Wireless sensors and specialised communication protocols are used in the energy metres as part of this integration to enable real-time data monitoring and transfer.

articleTitle: Detecting Email Fraud Attacks Using Ensemble Machine Learning Method
abstract: An ensemble machine learning (ML) technique is used in this work to advance the precision of double-dealing email detection. Email fraud is still a main problem, often employing phishing and spoofing strategies that are very sophisticated and circumvent conventional security measures. This research intends to increase detection systems' presentation by applying the collective intelligence of numerous machine learning models inside an ensemble framework. These kinds of solutions are essential for protecting people and companies from monetary losses, data breaches, and harm to their reputations from unscrupulous email activity. This work developments the area of cybersecurity by providing a strong technique for detection and preventing email fraud attempts, strengthening overall digital resilience in today’s linked world through severe testing and analysis. Email is a productive means of communication. It is one of the most widely utilized forms of communication and can be employed for both legal and illicit purposes. Numerous characteristics that may be useful in identifying email fraud attempts are currently being researched. MATLAB is used to assess the email fraud filtering performance, and ML classifiers are tested experimentally within the Ensemble classifier. To increase performance, this research suggests using an Ensemble machine learning (EML) classifier with feature extraction to improve the classification accuracy of fake emails. Though the scam has changed and will probably change again, its basic idea of promising something in exchange for nothing and preying on people’s weaknesses has not changed. Fraud email detection’s precision and adaptability were assessed utilizing characteristics, such as recently suggested features. where flowing large data can be considered. To automate the many processes of KD, we can explore implementing an automated fraud detection system in addition to including attachment functionalities in our future work.

articleTitle: Precision in Prediction: A Comprehensive Assessment of Diabetes Forecasting through Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: Worldwide, millions of individuals battle with this persistent form of diabetes. Diabetes is a complex health condition that has implications for individuals and healthcare systems. This research employs machine learning algorithms, capitalizing on the Pima Indian Diabetes dataset to predict diabetes in individuals. For that we used several ML models, includingRandom Forest (, Decision Trees (DT), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Logistic Regressions (LR), KNearest Neighbors (KNN) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). These results suggest the potential to enhance diabetes prediction methods, which could have an impact on healthcare outcomes and resource allocation. The findings indicate that specific models demonstrateaccuracy, and the use of visual representations assists in evaluating the capabilities of these models. This research highlights the importance of data driven approaches in addressinghealth concerns and underscores the potential of machine learning in medical applications. Healthcare professionals might use this method to identify those who are at risk of developing diabetes and take preventative action. In summary this research adds to the changing field of healthcare by imagining a future where data-based understandings enable better disease prognosis benefiting both individuals and healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Amalgamation of Technologies for Smart Monitoring of Sustainable Aquaculture
abstract: Aquaculture becomes a diverse segment and follow- up considered substantial stress taken over the innovation to achieve sustainable development. Various applications deploy enhanced fish production, biodiversity selection, illness remediation, reduced waste production, and prevention of environmental damage which can be utilized technologically to achieve sustainability. The present study provides the evaluation of various digitalized technologies for assisting support and innovation in aquaculture. The Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud computing, and others used to boost efficiency and production demonstrate the decreasing waste pollution. As a result, addressing pressing issues through the global digitization of the fisheries and aquaculture industries will support several United Nations sustainable development goals focused on the application of disruptive technologies. Different functions and previous backgrounds of digitalized technologies have been evaluated and depicted in the form of a table in the current article. Challenges faced by the technology as well as future recommendations have been provided in the current study.

articleTitle: The Role of Machine Learning in Equipping Students with Emerging Opportunities
abstract: The growth of the machine learning (ML) process is crucial to evaluate the basic influence on the growth of students' life. Main advantage of using ML in education is that it can be used to generate individualized learning programs that meet the desires of each learner. Large-scale information on student performance, learning preferences, and styles may be examined by ML algorithms to build personalized learning paths. This level of personalization accounts for each learner's unique learning style and pace to ensure that they receive just the appropriate amount of challenge and support. For instance, adaptive learning platforms with machine learning abilities can maximize student engagement and learning efficiency by dynamically modifying the material trouble in response to real-time student performance. Another way that machine learning is being incorporated into education is through the presence of relevant, up-to-date knowledge to the syllabus that tracks business trends. The need for expertise in fields like data analytics, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence is rising as the labor market changes. Educational institutions may identify growing skill requirements and modify their courses accordingly by regularly analyzing labor market data with the use of ML. By ensuring that students possess the abilities that employers value, they increase their competitiveness and adaptability in the labor market. There are some different prospectuses that allows determining the basic impact of the motivated student's aspects to the improvement of their studies. In addition, maintaining appropriate ideas in the machine learning process allows for the organization of some better approaches where the student's activity is analyzed appropriately. All of the opportunities defined in the machine learning process are determined basic approach which is described the student's improvement in their growth process. There is the basic approach where the impact of the machine learning procedure is to evaluate the improvement of students' life appropriately.

articleTitle: AI-based effective transport management system using fused WSN data
abstract: As the number of possibilities for WSNs progressively grows, more people are trying to address the issues that are limiting their growth in the form of two main significant power consumption and delay. The principal solutions to such issues involve better traffic control and administration. In this research, we proposed a deep reinforcement learning-based traffic-control system that views congestion control as a method of learning strategies to conserve energy. This technique employs a deep neural network to adapt, which inputs the WSN broadcaster's current status and generates the optimal routes possibly. We conducted simulation studies to show the proposed approach is a feasible scheme and appropriate to regulate congestion in WSN and decrease energy consumption.

articleTitle: Low Power Estimation for Multibit Memory Writing and Reading in Hardware Chip Design
abstract: The development of parallel programming models can be traced back to the parallelism and hardware synchronization verification that is required for an architecture to perform its intended functions. The research article focuses on power estimation for multibit memory operation of writing and reading in hardware chips. The design is considered for 16 memory registers having 8-bit data synchronized with a single clock. The performance of the chip is analyzed for different sizes of input data with the hardware chip parameters such as power consumption, frequency, and delay. The parallel data processing in the registers helps for optimal delay and power estimation in the hardware. The chip simulation is verified on the Virtex-5 FPGA hardware kit for different data sizes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Aggregation Efficiency: Dynamic Energy-Aware Strategies in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: In today’s surplus world, wi-fi sensor networks are essential for many systems. This network encapsulates sensor nodes powered by irreplaceable batteries, preserving a fixed topology for displaying specific locations. Their efficiency makes it crucial for large data packages. Wireless sensor networks continuously analyze physical factors such as temperature, pressure, ambient soft, sunlight and humidity, dominating the process Energy consumption monitoring is a key task in this area. To address this framework, this paper proposes a different approach: a modified controlled, privacy-controlled approach to record collection. The method aims to reduce redundant sensitivity, thus increasing system lifetime by reducing the frequency of data transfer between nodes and large sinks A comparative study with existing methods shows how the proposed method is effective. Performance findings show that the proposed bundling method (MEBPP) provides high packet transmission values while consuming less power and extending network lifetime.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Renewable Energy: AI-Based Solutions for Sustainable Biofuel
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)'s role in biofuels provides an emerging and significant convergence at the relation of advanced technology and energy produced from renewable sources. The various aspects of biofuel production are being revolutionized by AI's data analytics, machine learning, and modelling and prediction abilities, from maximizing biomass utilization and increasing fuel production to enhancing methods of production and providing the preservation of the environment. This study presents, biomass production using AI to agriculture system by monitoring the use of resources in the field (soil and plant health, how much fertilizers are used and helps to improve the crop production and reducing the waste). AI in biofuels is used for optimizing the biofuel production like adjusting irrigation and fertilizers usage to maximize yield, conversion process like adjusting temperature, pressure levels improving to enhance the efficiency of biofuels. AI also helps in long-term benefits such as food, health, housing, protection etc. with sophisticated mechanism for future work. In this paper, discusses about the limitation and recommendation about the biomass production for consideration to reduce the feedstock poor quality and inconsistent and increase their efficiency of agriculture production using biofuel renewable resources.

articleTitle: Degradation trend identification and analysis of class-F winding using experimental and fuzzy inference system
abstract: An accelerated degradation of a three-phase permanent magnet synchronous servo motor having class-F distributed stator winding in a laminated steel stack is performed to identify the degradation trend of stator. Accelerated thermal ageing of stator winding is conducted at 175C, 195C and 215C. Fuzzy inference system (FIS) is further deployed to analyze the degradation of class-F winding. The validation of FIS with respect to experimental technique i.e. accelerated life testing (ALT), is done using Weibull distribution. Further, Bonferroni with 95% confidence level confirms the equality of both statistical and artificial intelligent technique.

articleTitle: Energy Sector and Carbon Trading in the Future: A Reference to India
abstract: Environmentalists are experiencing an increasing sense of concern on the subject of global warming, which is also forcing them to suffer financial losses at this time. Those environmentalists who are dedicated to the cause of conserving the environment try to promote legislation and businesses that might be of aid in this endeavor. As a result of this, there is now the possibility to trade carbon credits both inside and external of the measured zone, so achieving the establishment of a "carbon market" on a worldwide scale. As a consequence of the Kyoto Protocol, greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions are subject to restrictions, and the pre-determined emission limits are then distributed among the nation's several states. After that point, these nations will be required to exercise control over the emissions of greenhouse gases that are generated by the many business units and industrial facilities that are situated inside their borders. With a special focus on the potential to create the emissions market within the context of India, the objective of this article is to study the carbon market on a global scale. Specifically, the purpose of this essay is to investigate the carbon market.

articleTitle: Enhancing object recognition with resnet-50: an investigation of the cifar-10 dataset
abstract: This study explores object recognition experiments conducted using the CIFAR-10 dataset, a well-established benchmark in machine learning and neuromorphic computing. CIFAR-10 consists of 28x28 grayscale digit images, with 60,000 training samples and 10,000 testing samples, providing a robust evaluation platform for learning algorithms. Object recognition, pivotal in computer vision, has advanced due to deep learning techniques. The study aims to improve object recognition by employing the ResNet-50 architecture on CIFAR-10. ResNet-50, a potent 50-layer convolutional neural network, addresses gradient vanishing issues in deep networks, significantly enhancing object recognition accuracy. This research builds on prior CIFAR-10 studies focused on enhancing ResNet-50's object recognition performance. Utilizing the dataset's 60,000 images across 10 classes pushes object recognition boundaries. In conclusion, this study deepens our understanding of learning algorithms by applying them to CIFAR-10, especially ResNet-50. It underscores object recognition's importance and broad practical applications. Adopting deep learning, exemplified by ResNet-50, can boost object recognition's accuracy and efficiency, impacting domains like autonomous vehicles and image-based search engines.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: The Impact of Digital Workforce and Robotics in Ubiquitous Technology
abstract: The term globalization refers to the process that is used in order to develop the business in different platforms that are available in different global aspects. Therefore, in order to develop a business on various global platforms, the business organization needs to increase the brand popularity and focus on the improvement of the brand reputation and brand awareness. Therefore, to perform the above-stated functions, business organizations need to utilize different platforms that are available in digital technology. Moreover, it has been observed that digital technology also helps to improve the brand reputation among the population across the world.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Education through Holistic Application of Technology: A Blockchain-Powered Framework for Smart Learning
abstract: The convergence of blockchain technology and education has ushered in a new era of innovation and transformation in the field of learning. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for integrating blockchain into the educational landscape, offering a blueprint for developing a more secure, transparent, and efficient smart education ecosystem. The framework encompasses key aspects such as identity management, content sharing, student records, micro-credentials, financial transactions, governance, data privacy, interoperability, user interfaces, and scalability. By exploring the potential benefits and challenges of blockchain adoption in education, this research paper seeks to inspire educators, institutions, and policymakers to embark on a journey toward a blockchain-enabled smart education future. As the world witnesses the growing importance of lifelong learning and digital credentials, this framework paves the way for a more accessible, equitable, and globally recognized education system poised to meet the evolving needs of learners in the 21st century.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis of Object Tracking Using Radial Function Networks
abstract: A important method in several fields, including driverless cars, medical imaging, human-computer interaction, and investigation systems, is object tracking. Because of their flexibility to changes in object presence and ambient factors, as well as their capacity to estimated complex, non-linear functions, radial networks have become a potent tool for object stalking in recent years. The article conditions for the analysis of the radical working networking where the algorithm is a tracking segment that aims in moving the object. Object recognition is one of the most basic and centralized factor analyses in determining outputs having relevant values and a strong research background. Radial functioning is a phenomenon that has gained rapid training and desirable properties for improving the presentation of networking sites. radial networks, a form of artificial neural network, utilize radial basis functions as initiation functions. Because of this characteristic, RBF networks are especially well-suited for applications like object tracking that call for high accuracy in function approximation and pattern recognition. We explore the design of RBF networks in detail, emphasizing the functions of the input layer, output layer, and hidden layer using radial basis functions. We examine the mathematical foundations that allow RBF networks to represent intricate connections in the data, emphasizing how well they can generalize and interpolate.

articleTitle: Data Driven Decision Making in Insurance
abstract: In the competitive era collecting information about customers can be decisive factor that intends to pay more attention on offering competitive insurance products at the right time and provide vibrant opportunities for insurance companies to deliver great experience to end users. Moreover, relying on big data analytics can leverage companies in identifying people who are more pruned to risk due to accident claims and ease them to target with the motive of prevention and significantly reducing progressive cost factor for the firm on insurance. In a data driven insurance model big data are utilized by companies to furnish value added services, developing solutions, and providing valuable insights to comprehend the level of risk. Nevertheless, data driven insurance that has evolved due to rising customer credentials on digital interface, provide leverage to policy holders to realize and compare medical ridders or benefits and companies to develop personalized content in upselling and cross-selling, engaging more concern for customer care as well.

articleTitle: IoT-Based remote monitoring and control system for controlled enviornment precision farming of saffron
abstract: Farming is an essential industry that feeds the world's population. However, in recent years, there has been an increase in the demand for high-quality products, resulting in the adoption of precision agriculture. Controlled environment agriculture (CEA) has been gaining popularity. Precision agriculture refers to the agriculture practice where modern technology like IoT, WSNs are used to monitor the key metrics and therefore processes like irrigation, pesticide spray, etc. are initiated as and when required only, also at the required area only instead of traditional farming methods where the whole field was being sprayed although not all crops were in need. Apart from this, controlled environment farming is another method currently being used in farming of various crops, mainly for expensive and low yield crops where the environment of farming is artificially controlled to provide the best possible environment for the crop to grow and produce maximum yields. For the same, the Internet of Things (IoT) is a game-changer. IoT-based remote monitoring and control systems can provide real-time data on numerous key metrics such as temperature, humidity, and soil moisture. These data help farmers and other users to automate their farming, monitor growth and other aspects allowing them to improve their farming yield, reduce waste and costs from various sectors. In this study we are going to use the IoT tech stack to discuss and build a IoT based remote monitoring and control system for controlled environment precision farming of saffron which will be really beneficial for the saffron farmers to produce maximum yields while having all the metrics and controls within the reach of their fingerprints.

articleTitle: KOA Management in CDS using AI: A Review
abstract: Joint degradation is a symptom of osteoarthritis in the knee. In the entire world, it is the most common disease. KOA primarily affects elderly individuals even though life is tough at the KOA. Significant progress in artificial intelligence (AI) has been made in recent years; deep learning for picture categorization, lesion recognition, cartilage division, and future KOA development prediction models are among the most notable examples. In this study AI is used in detection and management of knee osteoarthritis based on various x-ray images. Now-a-days AI shows a great potential in the treatment of knee osteoarthritis. It's prerequisite to remember that these applications are still in their early days and need to be proved through real-life applications and clinical studies. The utility and accuracy of CDS for KOA will probably be improved by AI technologies. AI-powered CDS for osteoarthritis (OA) in the knee offers a lot of promise to help patients as well as physicians. In order to ensure the virtuous and proportionately deployment of AI in KOA treatment, it is imperative that this investigation address challenges with data integrity, ethics, privacy, and legal compliance. There is great opportunity for future research on knee OA in CDS to improve patient outcomes and our understanding of this chronic condition, as well as to increase the efficiency of healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Solution for Biogas Plant Operation
abstract: Incorporating Internet of Things (IoT) technology into biogas plant operations represents a new era of achieving optimized efficiency and sustainability in resource utilization. Decision-making concerning the selection of feedstock to be utilized in the biogas digester can be accurately obtained by the application of this advanced technology. Through real-time data collection and processing, informed decisions about the type and volume of feedstock can be obtained. Biogas plants can fine-tune their operations for optimal gas production while ensuring responsible resource management by monitoring different anaerobic digestion parameters including feedstock quality, moisture levels, and chemical composition of the substrate. This study explores the application of IoT in transforming the anaerobic digestion process and biogas plant operation in two important areas; a) feedstock selection; b) process control and monitoring system. The application of the Internet of things technology in a biogas plant operation improves sustainability, efficiency, and optimized output in form of enhanced biogas production with controlled operation backed by data driven decision making.

articleTitle: Fog Computing: An Emerging Paradigm for Edge Intelligence and Efficient Data Processing
abstract: Fog computing is a cloud computing extension that processes data locally on a device rather than uploading it to the cloud, which would speed up processing and lessen the strain on the Internet. We discuss fog computing applications, infrastructure, and technology in this paper. In particular, we showcase the most recent advancements in fog networking, platforms, security, privacy, cloud computing at the edge, and quality of experience. Lastly, we go over the difficulties that still need to be resolved, as well as the state of the field’s open research in fog computing.

articleTitle: Inconsistent behavior of pre-increment operators of C language
abstract: The C programming language serves as the foundation for nearly all programming languages in the computing world. Programming languages are changing as a result of technological breakthroughs and new approaches to problem solving. As a result of these developments, a number of compilers have been designed. These compilers differ based on the order in which the instruction in the program's code get executed. This paper demonstrates the difference among the various available C compilers such as Turbo C++, DEV C++ compiler, online compilers namely GDB compiler, Programmiz compiler by taking into consideration the concept of operator precedence and operator associativity. Operator precedence and operator associativity are the key concepts which deals with the evaluation of expression having multiple operators with different precedence and multiple operators with same precedence respectively. This paper aims to discuss implementations of these key concepts by providing the insights into pre and post increment operators.

articleTitle: Enhancing Public Wi-Fi Accessibility and Coverage through NuttyFi ESP8266 Wi-Fi Module Extension
abstract: Reliable and broad Wi-Fi get entry to has developed into a critical requirement in our contemporary, linked society. However, some of limitations prevent reliable Wi-Fi from being on hand in each crowded locations and underdeveloped areas. These challenges encompass issues like choppy sign strength, insufficient coverage, and the continuing virtual divide. It is hard to properly deal with these connectivity difficulties due to the pressure and fee of conventional Wi-Fi infrastructure deployment strategies. The NuttyFi ESP8266 Wi-Fi Module Extension is a creative solution that has been cautiously designed to enhance public Wi-Fi accessibility and insurance. The NuttyFi ESP8266 board, created solely to growth the attain and effectiveness of public Wi-Fi networks, combines versatility and affordability. The seamless integration of NuttyFi ESP8266 modules into current Wi-Fi infrastructure forms the basis of this endeavour. These modules function Wi-Fi sign boosters and are placed carefully in regions with poor connectivity or restricted accessibility.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Urban Horticulture and Agriculture with Networked Intelligence: A Blockchain-Based Framework for Smart Farming and Crop Management
abstract: Smart agriculture, which is a novel method of farming of the modern era, focuses on taking advantage of resource utilization and fostering sustainability as the pressure of feeding a continuously rising global population becomes inevitable. Blockchain technology is becoming known as a main solution in smart agriculture because of its ability to deliver efficiency, transparency and traceability across the agricultural value chain. This article in particular shows a well-thought-out plan for embedding the blockchain technology into smart farming. Essential topics including data collection, supply chain management, automation, security, integration, and adoption strategies are covered within this framework. The goal behind this model would be to remold agricultural production, intensify the involvement of stakeholders, and enable the agricultural industry to be more adaptive and creative with blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Fog Restoration in Hazy Images using Deep Transfer Learning
abstract: Issues like low vision and the distortion of spectral and spatial information in photographs can be brought on by unfavorable atmospheric circumstances including smog, rain, overcast sky, fog, and smoke. This piece looks at images taken in a hazy environment. While de-smogging requires veil and transmission map data, optical imaging systems are limited to capturing smoggy images. To restore blurry photographs, effective optical information prediction is necessary. Research has shown that optical information anticipated by the dark channel prior technique frequently produces subpar images in photographs with areas of higher brightness, noticeable pollution gradients, or textured information. In order to estimate optical information, this study makes use of Deep Transfer Learning (DTL) and Optimized Gradient Prior Prediction (OGPP).We gathered benchmark images of both smoggy and smog-free environments in order to train the DTL model. The OGPP technique uses the smog gradient, which the DTL model is taught to anticipate, to recover pictures free of pollution. A comparison analysis shows that when it comes to recovering hazy photos, the OGPP restoration model performs better than other approaches.

articleTitle: A Framework for Advanced Technology in Energy-Efficient Dew Computing for Smart Healthcare
abstract: By allowing for remote patient monitoring, real-time diagnostics, and efficient healthcare data administration, smart healthcare technologies are transforming the medical business. However, energy consumption and latency concerns have been raised due to the growth of resource-intensive healthcare applications in cloud-based infrastructures. This study introduces a novel method for overcoming these obstacles by developing a Dew Computing framework optimized for smart healthcare settings that is both energy-efficient and scalable. This system, influenced by Dew Computing, brings cloud functionality to the network's periphery, where data and medical equipment functions are created. The framework prioritizes hardware selection that is light on energy consumption, dynamic allocation of resources, efficient data management, and encrypted communication channels. Our extensive analysis demonstrates the suggested framework's usefulness and low energy use in practical healthcare settings. Through our experiments, we have found that considerable decreases in energy use are possible without compromising the safety or quality of healthcare services. This study provides an energy-efficient answer for the development of future smart healthcare systems, adding to the expanding body of knowledge on edge computing and its applications in healthcare technology.

articleTitle: Detecting adversarial examples using constraint-based learning
abstract: Deep learning models have been applied in various fields and continue producing exceptional results. However, these models are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which are modified data samples maliciously crafted to cause misclassification by a target model. Fields like Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are security-critical; therefore, adversarial attacks pose a high risk in such applications. The attacker not only aims for evasion but also tries to launch an attack once the adversarial example has evaded detection by a NIDS. This paper presents a novel technique for detecting adversarial examples targeted towards a NIDS by learning the dependencies between features known as domain constraints. Our proposed method detects adversarial examples that violate these constraints learned during training. Compared with prevalent detection techniques, our method does not require generating adversarial examples for training, which reduces its computational requirement. We assume a grey-box threat model where the attacker can access the training data. We perform experiments on the CICIDS2017 dataset against five state-of-the-art adversarial attacks: FGSM, BIM, PGD, Deep fool and BIM. The results show that our method can detect up to 100% adversarial attacks, outperforming the contemporary schemes.

articleTitle: Justifiable Agriculture Productivity with Nimble, Cost-Effective, and Optimized Resource Framework - A MIST Computing Approach for Smart Agriculture
abstract: Smart agriculture, made possible by contemporary technologies, is gaining prominence as conventional farming faces more severe challenges. This research looks into the feasibility of using MIST (Microservices, Internet of Things, Serverless, and Edge Computing) computing to create an inexpensive framework for smart agriculture. The importance of "smart agriculture" to the future of farming and food production is explored in this study. Then, the revolutionary potential of MIST computing to address the unique difficulties of smart agriculture is stressed. Smart agriculture is used to evaluate the findings and highlight the research's practical implications, which include benefits for farmers, resource optimization, and sustainability. The study's limitations are addressed, and potential future research directions are proposed. Low-cost MIST computing frameworks that allow for smart agriculture is one of the key issues proved in this research and is of essential importance to agriculture sector. This method obviously shows the size of soy bean yields growth, as well as the decrease costs of technologies in which the farm will have access in different ways to data acquisition, processing and analytics. The gap is big, because it is bringing community efforts together with no chemicals, green, tech process, and food production as a response to the world population needs.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive review on House Prediction System
abstract: Predicting the prices of the houses accurately is a very difficult task in the real estate industry. In the last few years, due to the readiness of huge datasets and progress in the machine learning techniques, researchers have attempted to the develop models that can accurately predict house prices. In this paper, we want to build a house price prediction system that utilizes a dataset of residential housing prices to train and evaluate the predictive model. There is a lot of research which is being done in this field from the past few years such as the number of bedrooms, square footage, bathroom, location, and other factors. Overall, the research in this field contributes to the development of more accurate and efficient house price prediction models which builds the substructure for the future researches in this field.

articleTitle: Study of Smart Kitchen using Artificial Intelligence
abstract: With the improvement of economic system and generation and the non-stop improvement of medical and industrial acumen equipment, artificial intelligence has gone through evolution to go into the current domestic layout.Artificial intelligence can significantly lessen the everyday running time and power value andencourages the development of existence value. If we are saying artificial intelligence’s involvement in current domestic layout cannot be reversed, and the residing hobby of humans is changed regularly through machine, intelligence quotient is replaced regularly, that is possibly a double-edged sword. The motive of this chapter is to perceive the blessings of artificial intelligence utility in current domestic layout and replicate upon the hazards of its overinvolvement, and appearance out at the potentialities of the destiny of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Exploring the Growth of Blockchain Literature: Insights from 2016 to 2024
abstract: This bibliographic analysis research addresses the evolving landscape of blockchain research from 2016 to 2024. The introduction identifies the problem of understanding the current state and trends of blockchain literature, given the technology's rapid growth and diverse applications. Research gaps are identified in terms of understanding productivity, collaboration patterns, and emerging topics within the field. To address these gaps, the study conducts a comprehensive analysis using bibliometric techniques on data extracted from the Scopus database. The analysis reveals that China, the USA, and India emerge as the top three contributors, collectively accounting for 68% of the total publications and demonstrating substantial productivity and collaboration within the research community. Moreover, the study highlights the increasing focus on topics such as smart contracts (15%), digital storage (12%), and consortium blockchains (14%), indicating emerging areas of interest and research priorities. Security-related concerns remain prevalent, as evidenced by the frequent co-occurrence of keywords related to network security and cryptography. Additionally, the analysis underscores the diverse range of applications and implications of blockchain technology, spanning industries such as finance, supply chain management, and healthcare. By synthesizing these findings, the study contributes to a deeper understanding of the evolving landscape of blockchain research and provides insights for future research directions and collaborations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Network Security in Smart AI Environments: Innovative Approaches to Detecting Anomalies
abstract: Network intrusion poses a significant threat to the security of modern network communications, necessitating the development of effective intrusion detection systems (IDS) to safeguard network services and data. Machine learning techniques have become strong tools for identification of suspicious patterns in network traffic. This paper proposes ensemble learning using both SVMs and the Random Forest for network intrusion detection. The performances of the proposed methods are evaluated using the enhanced version of the KDDCUP’99 dataset, known as the NSL-KDD dataset. The main focus of our intrusion detection algorithm is to classify incoming network traffic as normal or malicious based on the given 41 features describing each pattern of the traffic. The accuracy in our approach is far above 95%, with the best classifier being Random Forest, which outperforms SVMs. This is an outstanding achievement in smart environment network security and privacy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antennas for High-Performance WiMAX Communication
abstract: In this manuscript, a low-profile rectangular microstrip patch antenna for WiMAX communication systems is presented. The research aims to enhance the microstrip patch antenna's functionality to find its suitability in smart devices. The suggested patch antenna is appropriate for usage in handheld devices because of its small construction, which measures 26mm×35mm×1.6mm when the ground plane is included. The antenna's frequency band is successfully optimized at 3.65 GHz, the appropriate frequency for WiMAX communication, with a very high S-parameter (S11) of -38dB, and it exhibits an efficiency of more than 90%. The proposed design has an omnidirectional radiation pattern with a gain of 1.7 dBi and VSWR is 0.413. FR4 material is used as a substrate of the microstrip antenna. This paper provides a parametric analysis of the antenna's dimension.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Tuberculosis Treatment: Smart Technology Innovations for Mycobacterium tuberculosis Management
abstract: Tuberculosis remains a significant global problem. The modification in smart technology (ST) invention generates novel chances to reform tuberculosis (TB) controlling. This work explores the potential of ST for filtering MTB diagnostics and therapy. ST includes telemedicine, mobile health uses (mHealth), wearable devices (WD) and data analytical that deliver many options of improving TB control. Telemedicine licenses distant consulting thus empowering medics to access patients in remote areas, offer quick detects as well as recommend treatment. mHealth apps certify that individuals have right of entry to education materials, can remind them when it’s time for medication and offers self-monitoring tools which enhance adherence to the therapy by keeping the patient involved during the course of treatment. WD support real-time (RT) monitoring of heart rates, blood pressure level, physical activity and other vital signs that are important in coming up with modified remedy plans while also detecting response to cure earlier enough. Data analytics combined with AI can examine large amounts of patient data to identify patterns, forecast drug effects and optimize treatment strategies resulting in more efficient individualized care. These novelties through intellectual technologies may be used as solutions for tasks experienced during TB management, leading to improved patient outcomes and a reduction in the TB burden.

articleTitle: Smart GuardianChain: A Solution Based on Blockchain Technology for Ensuring Security of E-Health Records in a Smart Environment
abstract: In the age of rapidly progressing technology, the healthcare sector is embracing the revolution of digital transformation through the widespread adoption of Electronic Health Records (EHRs). Nevertheless, the digital realm also presents notable challenges, particularly pertaining to the security and confidentiality of patients' delicate health data. This document introduces the innovative Smart GuardianChain, a blockchain-based distributed system crafted to tackle these pivotal concerns by establishing an infallible, decentralized, and impervious platform for the management and sharing of EHRs.Smart GuardianChain capitalizes on a robust consensus algorithm to ensure the integrity of EHRs, thus safeguarding the genuineness of medical records in an increasingly interconnected healthcare ecosystem. To guarantee that solely authorized entities have access to patient information, the system integrates an intricate mechanism for access control. Patients are bestowed with complete authority over their EHRs, enabling them to manage access permissions as they deem appropriate. Through extensive experimentation, our results demonstrate the scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness of the proposed system, which not only enhances security but also preserves patient privacy. By addressing the pressing privacy challenges that EHR systems face today, Smart GuardianChain stands poised to revolutionize the quality of healthcare services, fostering trust and confidence in the digital healthcare landscape.

articleTitle: Node MCU and Lily Pad based Relay Protection System For Laboratory Micro-Grid
abstract: The ambitious 2030 UN Sustainable Development Goal of achieving sustainability across social, environmental, and economic dimensions has spurred the global community to develop novel solutions across a range of fields. Energy infrastructure, with an emphasis on producing clean and renewable energy sources, is one key sector where innovation has become paramount. Microgrids have turn out to be a capacity alternative to overcome the problems with conventional centralised energy grids as part of this large sustainability push. Localised strength distribution structures called microgrids can run one at a time from or in cooperation with the principle grid. They are environmentally useful and beneficial in reducing greenhouse gasoline emissions because they're often fueled by way of renewable power resources like sun panels and wind mills. However, troubles with balance and efficiency have avoided microgrids from being widely used. Maintaining balance in microgrid systems is a primary trouble, particularly while incorporating variable and intermittent renewable electricity assets. For the related network or facility with a purpose to meet its strength wishes, a regular and dependable strength supply should be supplied. In order to maximize power efficiency and decrease waste, microgrid operations have to be run greater effectively overall.

articleTitle: EV Battery Management System using IoT
abstract: For the long-life of E-V batteries and to progress the performance so there is a demand for efficient battery management systems (BMS). This work signifies an IoT-equipped EV battery management system. It makes use of IoT technologies to optimize and monitor E-V battery charge efficiency. By using various sensors, data analytics algorithms, communication software and methods E-V BMS captures real-time values from the E-V battery. All useful sensors are neatly located to capture various battery properties like current, temperature, and voltage. The advanced communication tools, as cellular area networks and Wi-Fi are used for the purpose of data transmission and reception from the central control area unit.
