articleTitle: How is digitalization reshaping the landscape of Rural banking in India?
abstract: India has a wide network of rural bank branches in India and is one of the developing nations that has initiated the process of digitalization at a faster rate as compare to others. With augmentation of customer expectation and computer usage, the delivery of banking service through e-banking or mobile banking has become ideal for banking customers to meet their expectations. The rural banking system is primarily including low-middle-income group in these areas. Still rural branches in India been regarded as a step-child of banking system in India. Rural banking sector has to face many challenges despite increase in number of consumers and awareness among customers. This paper discussed the development and growth of rural banking system in India and focusing on some emerging trends in rural banking

articleTitle: Multiplexer design and analysis using 18nm FinFET Technology
abstract: Multiplexer is a basic block of many processors or ready to use board like FPGA’s. This work explores multiplexer design with different technology and logic style for improvement in performance. Conventional CMOS technology is useful at 45nm and above technology due to low power consumption and perfect logic zero and logic transition. Advantage multiple gates in FinFET technology makes it more suitable for high-speed logic transitions. Use of FinFET increases drive current and improves the circuit speed at compromise in term of power. FinFET technology with logic style improves power overhead on IC per unit area. In this paper, a multiplexer is designed using 18nm FinFET and result are compared with CMOS technology for similar operating conditions. Also, FinFET is explored with different logic style for the optimization in delay and power calculations. All the design and simulations are performed on Cadence Virtuoso.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Machining Conditions Using Machine Learning
abstract: Improving additive manufacturing (AM) process modelling is necessary to better understand the relationship between process parameters and material properties, and current developments in AI and ML offer promising avenues for this. Although the proliferation of labelled datasets from experiments or high-fidelity simulations has been the main driver behind the development of traditional AI tools in data science, it is becoming more and more necessary to use AI in AM metal processes while reducing reliance on big datasets. Our solution to this is the Improved Neural Network (INN) framework, which improves the modelling process by incorporating knowledge of basic physics concepts like momentum, energy, and mass conservation into the neural network design. In order to effectively enforce boundary conditions and speed up the modelling process, we include compressed-type approaches into the Dirichlet boundary condition regulation using a Heaviside function. The INN framework is used to two typical metal manufacturing challenges, one of which is the NIST AM-Benchmark series test. We thoroughly examine the effectiveness of the INN framework employing a finite element variational multi-processing training method by comparing its predictions with available experimental data and high-fidelity simulation findings. By utilising additional physical data, the results show that the INN can consistently forecast temperature and melt pool dynamics in metal AM processes, even with a limited quantity of labelled datasets.

articleTitle: IoT Intervention in the monitoring of aquaponics metrics and control of input schedule
abstract: The extensive use of technology across several Modern civilization is clearly impacted by technology, with cutting-edge techniques and tools playing critical roles in sectors including healthcare, business, agriculture, and education. Processes have been transformed by these improvements, which have increased their dependability and efficiency. With the incorporation of technology, agriculture has made enormous strides, with techniques like aquaponics developing as extremely effective and sustainable systems. Aquaponics is a novel farming method that combines hydroponics (soilless plant cultivation) and aquaculture (fish farming) to grow vegetables and fish at the same time. But the performance of this incorporated system relies upon on careful observation of a number of vital elements, such as water high-quality, pH tiers, temperature, and dissolved oxygen levels. To keep the health and growth of both fish and flora in an aquaponics device, it's miles critical to hold perfect situations. This highlights the significance of technological intervention, especially via the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) era, and calls for precision in regulating the input time table for fish feed and plant vitamins.

articleTitle: Analysis of Feedback and Customer Satisfaction Parameters for Hospitality Industry-A Technology Intervention
abstract: Technologies are the patronage for the sustainable development and growth in the field of hospitality industry. Today’s hotel visitors are accustomed to using remote keyless entry to open and lock their vehicles, placing food orders directly from a smartphone app, and using the technology to switch on the needful thing, add something to their shopping list, or to on the Television and music also. Many of these visitors also anticipate having the same frictionless experience while staying at hotels. Prior studies tended to be preoccupied with technological service innovation, leaving human-related service innovation relatively unexplored. TBSI (Technology Based Service and Innovation) can be examine in this study to develop the sustainable application and system can have the stronger role for the customer satisfaction and delight. For the hospitality business to flourish and grow quickly in the future, we now also need to know what the customers are saying. In this study, we focus on technology and how it may help the hotel sector grow based on client input.

articleTitle: Smart Next-Generation Revenue Growth: A Methodology for Partitioning Customers Utilizing the K-Means Algorithm and RFM Model
abstract: Customer segmentation & pattern extraction are pivotal elements in a business's decision-making process, particularly in highly competitive industries. Swiftly identifying & understanding the potential of customers is crucial for a successful expansion strategy. This paper introduces an innovative, integrated approach for pinpointing target customers & optimizing revenue generation for organizations. The primary objective of this study is to categorize customer data into distinct groups based on their unique characteristics, employing the K-means algorithm. Additionally, the RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) model is applied to rank & group customers according to their recent transaction behaviors. To assign new customers to appropriate clusters, a mean value is utilized as the primary indicator.The paper employs the Elbow method for an initial selection of the number of clusters & the Davies-Bouldin score to determine the optimal cluster count. The results are visualized through flattened graphs & Snake plots for different K values, enabling a comprehensive analysis of the clusters and aiding in the finalization of the optimal K value. This research presents a powerful framework for customer segmentation, ultimately supporting managers in making informed strategic decisions and enhancing an organization's revenue potential.

articleTitle: Improving Parking Management: Leveraging IoT to Empower Smart Environments
abstract: In the realm of the present-day urban landscape, the management of parking has emerged as a prominent concern owing to the incessant growth of vehicles. The conventional parking systems of yore often find themselves in a predicament when confronted with the demands of contemporary cities, resulting in inefficiency, congestion, and environmental predicaments. In an endeavor to confront these challenges headon, this document delves into the notion of "Enhancing Parking Management: Harnessing the Power of IoT to Empower Intelligent Environments." This investigation offers a glimpse into the fundamental motifs, incorporating the amalgamation of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to fashion astute and responsive parking environments for the future. The IoT possesses an immense capacity for transformation, residing within its remarkable capability to forge connections among diverse constituents of the parking ecosystem. These constituents include cameras, mobile applications, and sensors, which collectively gather and scrutinize data in real-time. Such an approach, driven by data, empowers the creation of intelligent parking systems that maximize the utilization of space, elevate the user's experience, alleviate traffic congestion, and mitigate the environmental footprint. By capturing the essence of the Internet of Things, parking facilities have the ability to bestow upon drivers the gift of real-time updates regarding the availability of parking spaces, allowing them to effortlessly discover vacant spots. Moreover, intelligent parking systems have the potential to assist parking operators in optimizing their revenue, thereby enhancing the allocation of resources and operational efficiency. Moreover, the environmental implications of IoT-empowered parking solutions cannot be overstated. Reduced circling for parking spaces results in decreased emissions, contributing to a greener and more sustainable urban environment.

articleTitle: Segmentation Study on Bank Customers Based on RNN
abstract: Effective Customer Relationship Management Customer relationship management is critical as an indication of a firm’s future growth in times of technological change and shifting relationships between firms and consumers. This research focuses on customer segmentation as an important strategy to strengthen the relationship between the business and the customers. Customer segmentation is the overall approach of subdividing a customer database into groups based on characteristics and behaviour’s common in each segment. The research applies the K-means clustering technique to segment customers into six distinctive groups based on annual incomes and expenditure scores, and two main components. If the clustering results are effective, this will allow businesses to make decisions based on data, which contributes to enhancing their product and service range, making rapid adjustments according to altered customer needs. The main aim of the current research project is to prove the effectiveness of RNN-based customer segmentation with the use of mean values as a guiding signal for the assignment of new clients into the relevant clusters. The ability to use RNNs for high precision consumer segmentation is critical for sustainable competitive advantage in the market marked by rapid evolution and hence extreme competition.

articleTitle: Smart AI basedVolume Control System: Gesture Recognition with OpenCV & Mediapipe Integration
abstract: The “Gesture Control System for Volume Control Revolutionizing the very landscape of human-computer interaction with the latest in technology, ”Using OpenCV & MediaPipe," as the demand increases for intuitive control of audio volume completely hands-free, in fact, eliminating mechanical knobs and buttons and allowing natural hand gestures to do the work. The two main technologies the system is based on are OpenCV for the camera-based gesture recognition and MediaPipe for the accurate hand tracking. Users can easily and smoothly adjust audio levels with basic hand moves, reducing the interaction process’s complexity and eliminating the need for physical controls or long, complicated menu navigation. But just as impressive is the level of adaptability this system can offer beyond volume control: Seamlessly finding its way to smart homes, automotive interfaces, and more, it is likely to emerge as a multidimensional solution for human-computer interaction. In essence, “Gesture Control System for Volume Control Using OpenCV & MediaPipe” is a gargantuan leap in technology that touches on user interface design and development in the application; hence, it fuses computer vision and machine learning to give an intuitive and hands-free method to audio volume control, therefore giving possibilities to a wide application domain.

articleTitle: Advancing Healthcare: CNN-Based Brain Hemorrhage Detection in Intelligent Environments
abstract: In the realm of medical diagnostics, in time detection of brain hemorrhage is paramount, as the failure to identify & address this condition promptly can result in irreversible brain damage or even fatality. Recent advancements in deep learning, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown remarkable potential in recognizing & classifying various medical disorders based on imaging data. In this research paper, we introduce a CNN-based approach for the identification of the cerebral hemorrhages using computed tomography (CT) images. Our proposed technique encompasses a preprocessing step for isolating the brain region within CT scans, followed by the training of a CNN model to categorize these images into two classes: normal & hemorrhage. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we conducted extensive experiments using a dataset comprising CT images obtained from patients both with & without cerebral hemorrhage. Our results reveal that the proposed CNN-based technique excels in identifying the cerebral hemorrhages & achieving an outstanding overall accuracy of 95.6% & an impressive specificity of 97.8%. This breakthrough in accuracy and specificity holds significant promise for enhancing the diagnostic process. By providing quicker and more accurate identification of this life-threatening condition, our approach has the potential to expedite the initiation of life-saving treatments, ultimately improving patient outcomes in cases of cerebral hemorrhage.

articleTitle: Smart Road Segmentation from Aerial Images
abstract: Road detection from satellite images plays a crucial role in enhancing map-generation efficiency, making it a valuable asset for various applications, including automotive navigation systems and emergency response systems. These abstract outlines a methodology for road extraction, emphasizing the importance of accurate and efficient techniques. The process begins with image segmentation to identify road network areas. Subsequently, a decision-making and continuity technique is applied to precisely recognize roads. Finally, a Vectorization step is employed to identify line segments representing roads. This approach accounts for the curved nature of roads, demonstrating adaptability when a fully automated system encounters challenges, necessitating a semi-automated approach. Road networks hold significant importance in diverse geospatial applications, such as cartography, infrastructure planning, and traffic routing software. Recent advancements in automatic and semi-automatic road network extraction have significantly improved extraction rates. Nonetheless, the effectiveness of road detection can be hampered by noise or low-frequency images. Furthermore, road edge detection is critical for determining road direction, obstacle placement, and assessing the size and speed of objects on the road. In this study, various road detection approaches are explored, leading to the development of a novel strategy based on the median filter. Comparative analysis against established techniques reveals substantial advantages in the proposed method, highlighting the need for more effective road detection approaches.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Healthcare: Forging the Path towards Intelligent Well-being and the Cutting Edge Environment 4.0
abstract: This article explores how AI-driven smart healthcare systems are revolutionizing healthcare, offering innovative solutions for disease diagnosis personalized treatments. It highlights their potential improve patient engagement, streamline administrative processes, and contribute to environmental sustainability. The paper discusses current challenges, future prospects, and opportunities for advancing these systems, benefiting healthcare professionals and researchers in creating smarter, eco-friendly healthcare environments.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity: Threats, Requirements, Deployments, Techniques, System Architecture, and Future Research
abstract: Cybersecurity safeguards computer systems, net- works, and digital information from a wide variety of cyber-attacks. Its major purpose is to protect the privacy of users’ data and resources while maintaining their integrity and making them accessible in the digital world. Cybersecurity is an area that receives investment from businesses, individuals, and governments all around the world in order to secure sensitive information, key infrastructure, and digital assets. Protection of Sensitive Information Both individuals and businesses store huge amounts of sensitive information digitally, including personal data, financial records, intellectual property, and trade secrets. This information must be protected in order to prevent unauthorized access or disclosure. The protection provided by cybersecurity prevents this information from being stolen, exposed, or accessed without authorization. Cyberattacks can result in severe financial losses, including theft of funds, fraud, and the expenditures associated with recovering from a cyber incident. It is possible to prevent these types of losses by taking preventative measures. Implementing these strategies helps prevent losses of this nature. In this paper, we propose a system architecture of a generic secure system, which can be deployed for various applications, i.e., smart healthcare, Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS), smart city, etc. We discuss the threats and attacks in cyberspace. Then, we explain the requirements of cybersecurity. Further, we discuss the devastation in the absence of cyber security. We also explain the cybersecurity deployments and techniques under cybersecurity. Then, in the end, some future research directions for cybersecurity are provided.

articleTitle: Real-Time Crop Monitoring System Using Deep Learning Techniques for Increasing Production
abstract: This study applies machine learning to determine rice crop production using sensor information from temperature, humidity, and water levels. This project looks forward to providing insights to maximize agricultural practices and allow data-driven decision-making in rice cultivation. This is in line with how well these disparate machine learning models can predict rice crop production when measured against precision, accuracy, recall, and F1 score. To some extent, this is evident, as this study found that the machine learning models can predict yield quite satisfactorily, of which the model Random Forest performs very well in terms of precision and accuracy. Among them were the exactitude of sensor data and the algorithm selection, along with subsequent model assessment, refinement, and the ingression of great datasets inclusive of a broader set of environmental characteristics and crop yields—that were considered to be crucial in improving the precision of yield prediction algorithms. Additionally, the use of machine learning in farming has a number of benefits, such as enabling farmers to make decisions about crop management, irrigation, and optimization of yield. Combining machine learning methodologies with sensor technology can optimize resource allocation, save water, and improve overall agricultural productivity. Further, this study will facilitate the implementation of smart irrigation systems and set the stage for data-driven decision-making in agriculture for better farming practices and food production worldwide.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for the Identification and Classification of Cardiovascular Diseases Using ECG Signals and Sensor data
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) continue to be a major concern in the medical field to date. Among the many diagnostic tools, electrocardiogram (ECG) remains one of the main ways with which to detect cardiac abnormalities. Although classic ECG interpretation is powerful, it is a laborious and time-demanding task and tends to be onerous for physicians. This study suggests a means of effective machine learning to increase the accuracy and speed of diagnosing CVDs based on ECG signals and other sensor data. On the other hand, we are concerned with the application of Frequency Domain Measures in deep-learning methodologies of image classifiers. Other models include the raw ECG sent to a 1-dimensional convolutional model together with the XGBoost model for the time-series feature-based prediction. Preliminary assessment reveals that Frequency Domain Measures provide good atrial fibrillation prediction but are quite limited for other types of arrhythmias. Computational results for the XGBoost model are, however, efficient for predictions on long data but proceed at the cost of extended inference times, considering the computational demand of the pre-processing stage. This paper opens up the scope of the potential for machine learning in revolutionizing ECG-based CVD detection, and we have to keep on the protocols of refinement and research toward this usage.

articleTitle: Smart Crypto Transactions: Pioneering of the Digital Economy
abstract: The proliferation of cryptocurrencies in digital transactions has been driven by their inherent security and decentralized attributes. However, this surge has simultaneously introduced novel challenges concerning security and efficiency. In this research paper, we delve into the realm of data mining techniques as a means to augment the security and efficiency of cryptocurrency transactions. Through a comprehensive review of existing literature, we pinpoint gaps in the current knowledge landscape. Subsequently, we propose a rigorous methodology for the collection and analysis of data from diverse sources, encompassing the blockchain, user behavior, and transaction history. Leveraging advanced statistical and machine-learning methods, we dissect this data to unveil patterns, anomalies, and potential threats, thus laying the foundation for a smarter and more secure digital economy within the smart environment.

articleTitle: Integrating Circular Economy and IoT For Sustainable Resource Management
abstract: The fourth industrial revolution is represented by technological advancements that can be noticed in almost every sphere of our daily lives. Integrating these technological advancements with the phenomena of the circular economy not only contributes to the global sustainable development goals but also presents a regenerative approach, a sustainable approach as compared to the traditional linear "take make dispose" method. The application of IoT for promoting the phenomena of circular economy possesses the potential of transforming entire industries thereby increasing overall sustainability and promoting responsible resource management paving the way for more ecofriendly practices. This study provides a detailed overview of different applications of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology for promoting the phenomena of circular economy to deliver sustainable resource management. The transformative impact of circular economy and IoT convergence provides transparency and quality control for better consumer engagement and insights.

articleTitle: Trackbot’s Journey Revolution: Smart Travel
abstract: In recent years, the integration of sensors into mobile devices has witnessed a remarkable surge in popularity, notably within the realm of health & fitness. Smartphones, with their built-in sensors, have rendered many standalone auxiliary devices, such as pedometers & heart rate monitors, obsolete. android, as a dominant operating system for smartphones, has equipped its devices with an array of sensors, including the gyro- scope, orientation, & accelerometer, making it an ideal platform for crafting mobile sensor applications. This research delves into the conception & realization of an android application tailored to harness the device’s sensors. The application’s core functionality revolves around detecting the user’s walking motion, performing signal analysis, computing walking distance & calories expended, facilitating efficient backtracking in unfamiliar locations, & delivering real-time feedback to the user. Notably, this innovative application provides to individuals looking to monitor their fitness objectives & track their physical activity, all without the need for additional hardware. The realm of mobile sensors extends well beyond health & fitness monitoring. These sensors have found application in providing location-based services, encompassing facilities like GPS navigation & augmented reality applications. The mixture of sensor technology with smartphone capabilities not only simplifies daily life but also holds immense promise for enhancing user experiences across various domains, heralding a future where hassle-free travel & very efficient fitness tracking is but a touch away.

articleTitle: Study on the Factors Influencing Investment Behaviour of Investors
abstract: Investors’ investment behavior can be characterized by their attitude and perspective toward depositing their funds in the numerous available channels. Investment prudence is crucial for achieving financial security. A person is always searching for a new investment opportunity that offers the highest and quickest returns. This paper aims to determine the relationship between individual investors’ financial behavior and investment decisions. The development and expansion of behavioral finance have revolutionized the financial sector. Investors need to make sound decisions while choosing the investment options. The only action taken by investors is a reaction to the information they currently possess. This paper also focuses to comprehend how Indian private investors perceive various investment opportunities by using a structured questionnaire to gather primary data. The study’s sample consists of 200 respondents from the Delhi NCR Region. The research employed numerous methodologies, including the Garrett ranking system, a straightforward percentage method, and others. Before engaging in various investment options, investors should conduct as many fundamental, technical, and financial analyses as possible, according to the results of the study. Investors should consider all available investment options when allocating capital and should diversify their investment.

articleTitle: Using AI-Based Techniques with Prisoners Who Suffer from Mental Illness
abstract: The issue of mental health among incarcerated individuals is not a recent development, but rather a longstanding concern that has been persistently neglected for many years due to the expectation that defendants should endure challenging circumstances. Since its inception, the act of imprisoning an individual has been associated with the imposition of physical and psychological distress upon the incarcerated individual. Throughout history, there has been a predominant focus on the concepts of deterrence and retribution, rather than prioritizing the rehabilitation process. Nevertheless, with the transformation of the state's position from a laissez-faire stance to that of a welfare state, there has been a notable transition towards emphasizing the rehabilitation of incarcerated individuals. This study explores the mental health difficulties experienced by detained individuals within the prison system and the obligation of prison staff to promptly detect mental health concerns and provide appropriate interventions. Furthermore, this study examines the possible implications of incorporating. via facial recognition methods in the monitoring and rehabilitation of incarcerated individuals.

articleTitle: Enhancing COVID-19 Diagnosis through Deep Learning on a coupled Edge-Cloud Computing technique using CT Scan Images
abstract: The present research looks at how deep learning models may improve the accuracy of COVID-19 diagnosis using CT scan pictures. The project aims to improve the detection of COVID-19-specific patterns and features by using the capabilities of the VGG19, DenseNet201, and VGG16 models. The training and assessment were based on a collection of 2,521 CT scan images from patients with cardiac problems as well as those who tested positive for COVID-19. To assess the models' diagnostic abilities, performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and specificity are used. DenseNet201 regularly beats the competition across all key measures, revealing its potential for accurate COVID-19 diagnosis. The suggested edge-cloud architecture further integrates the models into real clinical scenarios. Given the important role of false negatives and false positives in medical diagnostics, the results highlight the need of looking at more than just accuracy. These models are useful diagnostic tools, but they should not be used in place of hands-on medical treatment. This study adds to the increasing body of knowledge at the interface of artificial intelligence and healthcare by providing insights into how deep learning models may be used to improve COVID-19 diagnostic accuracy and perhaps modify medical practices. To fully realize the promise of these findings in enhancing patient care and healthcare systems, more cooperation between machine learning researchers and healthcare practitioners is required.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Living: The Future of Smart Homes
abstract: An important area of attention is energy efficiency since artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms may control power use by identifying occupant habits and modifying systems accordingly. This not only lessens the impact on the environment but also generates significant financial savings over time. A new age of ease, effectiveness, and security for homeowners has arrived with the integration of AI in smart homes. Machine learning algorithms are used in AI-powered smart homes to automate and improve a variety of daily tasks. These solutions, which range from voice-activated virtual assistants to intelligent lighting and climate management, adapt and react to the particular tastes and demands of residents. AI-driven surveillance substantially improves security by utilizing tools like face recognition, predictive analytics, and remote monitoring to provide users piece of mind. Smart homes powered by AI provide advantages in terms of healthcare and wellbeing in addition to convenience and efficiency. Modern home-based health monitoring devices may measure vital signs and give early warnings of potential health problems. Reminders for taking medications and assistance for seniors who want to age in place can improve quality of life. A unified environment that adjusts and anticipates inhabitant demands is created via interconnected gadgets and central control centers. Strong data protection and secure network protocols are necessary since cybersecurity and privacy are urgent issues. The key developments and future ramifications of AI-driven smart homes are summarized in this study

articleTitle: Advanced Digital Technological Solutions to Domestic Violence: A Brief Analysis
abstract: In spite of the fact that service providers, advocacy entities, and victims are iteratively refining violence prevention techniques in order to meet lockdown mandates, new evidence of the negative consequences of the pandemic on DV is still surfacing. Psychological and physical support for victims of DV is an essential resource that is increasingly being supplied utilizing digital and technology-based paradigms. These forms of assistance present a number of benefits and concerns, but overall, they offer a lot of potential benefits. This article provides a concise description of the existing ways to DV mitigation using digital solutions. It also identifies new best practices to support victims, their children, and abusers during and after lockdown recommendations by providing this information. The following are a few examples of different technologically based methods and solutions. Mapping out the present technological advances in response to pre- and postCOVID-19–related DV as well as describing the challenges with adoption, coverage, and meaningful usage of digital solutions should be an immediate priority.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of Wireless Ad-Hoc Network: Through TCP/IP Protocols
abstract: Remote correspondence is quickly taking the place of wired correspondence, posing new difficulties for Transmission Control Protocol (TCP). TCP is enhanced in a few ways to detect this issue. This paper addresses the protocol and display upgrade model for remote, specially designated computers over TCP. TCP is essentially a transport protocol created for web applications that are wired. However, the TCP misinterprets some conditions, such obstructions that slow down transmission and taint presentation quality, resulting in decreased throughput. This is because remote specially designated systems are unstable and vulnerable to unforeseen faults associated to geography. Because of poor connections and high congestion, TCP must be modified in order to prevent package loss. Accordingly, the evaluation of the recommended TCP presentation for a remote specially defined system is managed by this study.

articleTitle: AI-Based Modeling And Simulation Studies On Automation In Power Systems
abstract: The mechanized development of electric power systems realized via the application of artificial intelligence is proposed in this research as a new approach. Existing methods only evaluate dependability for a predetermined collection of design variables or don't take the program's dependability into account as a performance criterion. This methodology employs dependability measurements as the foundation for design optimization and builds a statistical association among design specifications and reliability. Making a stochastic proxy version of the voltage source inverter as the initial stage in this new structure will enable researchers to swiftly translate values describing operational circumstances and technical specifications onto variables describing the heat damage of converters. A specialized Artificial Neural Network (ANN) can be trained for this stage using modeling or empirical studies. The final system ANN1 can be used as a precise proxy converter model. Then, using a vast choice of design hyperparameters, this approach may be utilized to easily convert the annual mission’s pattern into a transient thermal pattern for every device. The collected results are then deployed to retrain ANN2, which develops into a depiction of the entire system that precisely converts the parameters into a lifespan usage expressed as an annual amount. An illustrative energy PV converter scenario employs ANN2 and the common conversion development tools to test the proposed methodology. This analysis revealed how to combine network dependability and outgoing sampling frequency to the best of its capacity while taking into account various technical restrictions. A training database that was utilized to develop the ANNs is also provided in this research.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of CNN-based Recommendation Systems
abstract: In today’s world, customers have millions of choices of products on e-commerce websites. To help them in not getting overwhelmed by all this variety and make informed choices, these sites employ recommendation systems that provide their customers with suggestions on what to buy. Due to the existence of many techniques, the selection of a technique is a complex task. In addition, each of these have their own features, advantages, and disadvantages. The field of recommendation systems has seen many new groundbreaking and novel techniques from considering the content of items to considering the behavior of related users from implementing NLP techniques to deep learning models there is much research undertaken by the researchers; one of them is using CNNs for both NLP-based approaches or image-based approaches. This paper aims to undertake a systematic review on the literature related to the fields of recommender systems, with a focus on the domain of e-commerce and systems created using CNNs. In the first section of the paper an overview of these systems is given followed by a literature review consisting of comparison between various studies, there algorithms, evaluation metrics and their advantages. Finally, the paper concludes by drawing conclusion of the review and providing future scope for research in this field. In this way, our review paper provides a comprehensive view of the literature related to CNN-based recommender systems.

articleTitle: Decoding the Script: A Bi-LSTM Based Journey into Doctor's Handwriting for Precise Prescription Understanding
abstract: Deciphering a doctor’s handwritten prescription has been a complex task for human beings. Research has been done to automate the understanding of handwritten text, but transcribing doctor’s handwritten prescriptions still requires the advancement to build a method that can be applied in real life. This paper presents a new hybrid model built on a fusion of CNN and Bi-LSTM architectures trained with CTC loss for the difficult task of decoding non-printed handwritten physicians’ prescriptions. The unification of signals such as spatial feature extraction (CNN) as well as sequential dependency decrease (Bi-LSTM) with the aim of misinterpretation mitigation retrieves a very high recognition accuracy over a single, segmented test collection. With iterative training methodology, which focuses on computational limitations, the approach results in continuous learning, thus eliminating the problem of overfitting. The given model is very good at understanding the heterogeneity of handwriting and contextual relationships in prescription texts. This scientific addition leads to improvements in patient care, streamlined workflows, and healthcare information management improvements as the ultimate performance of the model is the astonishing 98.40% accuracy level it offers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security for Online Transactions through Supervised Machine Learning in Credit Card Fraud Detection
abstract: This research probed the capabilities of supervised machine learning algorithms in credit card fraud detection, an essential facet of contemporary digital finance. Findings highlighted the predominant efficiency of the XGBoost algorithm, which recorded an accuracy of 97%, a precision of 94%, and an AUC of 0.97. Other notable performers included the Gradient Boosting Machine and Random Forest. The study underscores the potential of integrating advanced machine learning techniques to significantly enhance fraud detection systems, ultimately bolstering user trust and the security of online transactions. Recommendations for practitioner’s center on the adoption of algorithms like XGBoost and continuous model monitoring for adaptive defense against evolving cyber threats. Future research avenues might encompass the exploration of hybrid models and deep learning techniques to further refine fraud detection mechanisms. This study is seminal in that it serves as a reference point in the ongoing efforts of financial institutions to enhance their digital transactional protections.

articleTitle: A Paradigm Shifts in Enhancing Environmental Sustainability: AI and IoT for Smart Water Quality Applications
abstract: A significant decline in maintaining an irrigation system's water quality is one element that impacts public health. These toxins seriously threaten all of the aquatic ecosystem. Conventional techniques of water quality analysis are labour-intensive and time-consuming. With a real-time water quality monitoring system, it is, therefore, necessary to keep an eye on the water and take proactive steps to minimize pollution. The paper provides an overview of how technological advancements have aided in the development of effective strategies for quickly resolving several pressing problems. The Internet of Things (IoT) has garnered significant attention because of its intelligence and speedier processing. However, Artificial Intelligence (AI) approaches successfully statistically analyse massive amounts of historical data series in a short period and complex non-linear systems to improve modelling and forecasting. Finally, this study offers some recommendations and opinions.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Neural Network Model for Intracranial Tumor Detection and Classification System from MRI Scan
abstract: Medical diagnostics for detection of classification of MRI images for brain tumors have been researched and developed a lot in recent years. This paper proposes a novel automated scheme for the better accuracy of the tumor detection of MRI. The proposed method is designed with various steps, including adaptive filter for MRI image preprocessing, Region-Based Segmentation (RBS) for image segmentation, Gray-level Co-occurrence Matrix for the extraction of features, and classification based on recurrent convolutional neural networks. Experiments on the proposed method have been shown on a well-defined Kaggle dataset with 422 testing and 3278 training MRI images, and the proposed approach improves previous method results to an excellent 96.18% classification accuracy for all tumor types, including Astrocytomas, Oligodendrogliomas, Ependymomas, and non-tumors. The found methodologies put in the hands of RCNN show a DL model of superior classification of MRI tumor images over all methods, including BP (Back Propagation Neural Network) and U-Net, under all measures of merit. Improved performance of RCNN, with 96.18% accuracy, 95.9% precision, 96.5% recall rate and 96.2% F1-Score, to be accurate and reliable and serves as a better tool for expert medical practitioners in future tumor detection and classification.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cardiovascular Health with Machine Learning: Predictive Models and Beyond
abstract: Due to high incidence of cardiovascular diseases there is a need to establish good procedures for prediction. This article brings together an in-depth understanding on the application of machine learning techniques in prediction of cardiac disease. such models include logistic regression, RF, XGboost classification, SVM and neural network classification. Using a full range of data features and a comprehensive set of patient information from a wide dataset, the proposed model achieves significant performance in heart disease risk prediction. These different models can be used and compared to capture the complex relationship between the input factors and the reoccurrence of the sickness to subsequently develop an SI framework that is easy to understand and thus straightforward to communicate. Tests conducted on the models prove their efficacy compared to a benchmark in different measurements – lending further support to their potential application as decision support tools in medical domain. Thus, the work of this study could contribute to the overall effort of making heart disease endemic no more across the world with the broader body of knowledge on the use of machine learning to predict sickness.

Author Keywords: logistic regression. XGboost with Random Forest

articleTitle: Smart Predicators Forecasting Electricity: Using Machine Learning
abstract: The sudden increase in the demand of the sustainability and efficiency of the energy has coined the concepts of electricity consumption prediction. Accurate and reliable sources for prediction of energy have become very crucial, due to need of the efficient and sustainable energy growth. In this paper we have proposed a thorough methodologyfor creating a predictive model for predicting the usage of the electricity that includes the accurate and domain specific data and cutting-edge machine learning concepts. Networks based on neurons, long short time memory, are some of the concepts of machine learning we are going to use to analyze from the dataset’s complicated interactions and concepts. Meaningful information will be extracted from the produced result using feature engineering techniques and model performance optimization techniques. In calculating the accuracy of the model, we have considered both the short-term fluctuations in the result and the long-term trends of the actual electricity usage of the certain area. Various techniques have been used in this model such as Data Collection, Data Preprocessing, Feature Engineering, Model Training, Model Selection to improve the accuracy of the model. Accuracies of various models such as LSTM, ARIMA, RNN have been checked to improve the efficiency and accuracy of this model. This study will help the government bodies to supply the energy so there will be no scarcity and there will be no wastage of the energy in that area.

articleTitle: Preparation, Structure analysis and Antibacterial Properties of Iron Complexes mixed with 8-Hydroxyquinoline and Some Amino Acids
abstract: The 8-hydroxyquinoline (Q) has been used as a primary ligand in diverse ligand complex synthesis of Iron (II) and [Fe(Q)(L)2H2O] complex types, and amino acids (L) such serine, phenylalanine, and L-leucine have been used as secondary ligands. Analysis such as electrical conductance, magnetic susceptibility, spectroscopic and thermal studies have been used in metal complex analysis. The complexes’ electrical conductance investigations show that they are not electrolytic in origin. Measurements of magnetic susceptibility showed that the complexes were diamagnetic. Ligand charge transfer transition states can be observed in electronic absorption spectra. Proton (NMR)chemical environments are validated in addition to FT-IR studies demonstrating metal ion bonding through the ligand N- and O-donor atoms. Furthermore, analysis of thermal results show that coordinated water molecules are present. An agar cup and tube dilution procedure were used to investigate antibacterial activity of the complexes alongside the pathogenic bacterium P. aeruginosa, S. epidermis, P. vulgaris, and E. faecalis.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence for the Success of Supply Chain Operations in the Age of Data Analytics
abstract: The goal of artificial intelligence [AI] is to enable quick access to information and help users make wise decisions in the increasingly complicated digital world of today. Artificial intelligence [AI] has the power to completely transform the commercial world. Artificial intelligence can be used to better ship and manage logistics, forecast demand through data analysis, and spot supply chain inefficiencies. This lowers costs, shortens lead times, and enhances responsiveness to variations in demand. Surprisingly little is known about how data management may improve understanding of data on cycle time and supply chain sustainability, despite the growing use of data in decision-making. The majority of companies, according to the findings of the researchers, make use of big data analytics and artificial intelligence [AI] to make projections on the trajectory of the Supply Chain 4.0 industry. In this article, we take a look at how artificial intelligence can be applied to supply chain management [SCM] and analyze its potential applications. In this instance, a sample of 123 respondents from various SMEs were gathered for the study that followed. The study's objectives were determined using regression analysis, correlation analysis, case analysis, and descriptive analysis. Research demonstrates that artificial intelligence [AI] can help with inventory control, warehousing operations, enhancing security, and cutting operational expenses. The findings of the study indicated that, generally speaking, artificial intelligence will have a significant influence on the supply chain in the era of data analytics. It's expected to provide new opportunities for companies in a variety of sectors. Artificial intelligence [AI] can help both raise and decrease a product's strength and efficiency by predicting potential roadblocks before they arise. articleTitle: Real-time Obesity and Heart Disease Monitoring with IoT and Deep Learning
abstract: The accelerating spread of junk food consumption is progressively putting the younger generations at risk of obesity. The concept of health prioritization is deeply rooted in the development of nurturing and general welfare in society. The job has further become more complex by the glaring statistics of people across the globe who are fighting obesity. The World Health Organization (WHO) puts a staggering estimate that approximately 1 billion people across the globe suffer from obesity-related issues, a statistic heavy in terms of impact primarily because obesity greatly affects one's health but also holds fatal risks. Diagnosing the early stages of obesity can just be simple and prevent one from being obese; however, several obstacles stand in the way of its early diagnosis. Symptoms or signs that one is in the trajectory of suffering from obesity generally go unnoticed by the individual, and the availability of specialists to diagnose such risks persistently on time is not always possible. In this regard, the current paper shall showcase an application hitherto unknown using cloud-based diagnosis, in collaboration with machine learning through Secure Access Internet of Things to predict obesity-related risks without having to depend on glaring physical parameter indicators—in this regard, redefining how such information could be sourced even without the need of regularly visiting health professional people. To ensure the best possible health predictability from this machine learning, we gathered and plotted the datasets consisting of obese and overweight people. Other than machine learning, we use a Secure Access IoT sensor network. This allows for real-time monitoring and diagnosis, making early detection achievable. Consequently, this system paves the way for mitigating and substantially reducing the complications associated with obesity.
